tear.source: Youden threshold on out-of-fold predictions of the full automatic pipeline, KneeMRI (917 scans)

tear.dataset: KneeMRI (Rijeka), 917 PD fat-suppressed sagittal scans, 227 torn; 5-fold CV grouped by patient; full automatic pipeline (localizer slice + box, knee side unknown)

level.note: 55 complete and 172 partial tears; a dedicated 3-class MONAI model scored 0.61 (hand-drawn box), so it is not used

location.note: the localizer was probably trained on these same KneeMRI boxes, so its box overlap here is optimistic

acl_size.dataset: CEMRR kneeMRI-ACL, 110 expert-outlined slices, 5-fold CV (model without contrast augmentation)
acl_size.note: deployed decoder adds contrast / low-resolution augmentation; it gave more ligament-shaped outlines on fat-suppressed scans but was not re-cross-validated

level.source: Youden threshold for complete vs partial among torn scans, same predictions
